title: Pembrolizumab with paclitaxel and carboplatin
schedule_label: Combination every 3 weeks, then pembrolizumab alone.
schedule_summary: Pembrolizumab, paclitaxel and carboplatin on day 1 every three weeks for 6–8 cycles, according to benefit and tolerability. Pembrolizumab alone every three weeks while it helps and side effects are manageable.
purpose: Control the cancer, relieve symptoms and delay progression.
indication_text: Persistent, recurrent or metastatic cervical cancer with a PD-L1 combined positive score of at least 1.
administration_text: Intravenous treatment in the oncology day unit. Combination every 3 weeks, then pembrolizumab alone.
monitoring_summary: Blood counts and organ function are reviewed with symptoms and fitness for treatment.
review_status: Feasibility build. Clinical, pharmacy and patient review pending.

agents.name: Pembrolizumab
agents.explanation: It helps immune cells recognise cancer. The immune system can also inflame healthy organs.
agents.mechanism: It helps immune cells recognise cancer. The immune system can also inflame healthy organs.
agents.watch: Call about new symptoms during treatment or months after it ends. Carry your immunotherapy alert card.
visual: It helps immune cells recognise cancer. The immune system can also inflame healthy organs.

agents.name: Paclitaxel
agents.explanation: It disrupts cell division. Hair follicles, blood cells and nerves can also be affected.
agents.mechanism: It disrupts cell division. Hair follicles, blood cells and nerves can also be affected.
agents.watch: Report numbness and tell the nurse immediately if you flush or wheeze during treatment.
visual: It disrupts cell division. Hair follicles, blood cells and nerves can also be affected.

agents.name: Carboplatin
agents.explanation: It damages DNA in dividing cells. Kidney function helps determine the prescribed amount.
agents.mechanism: It damages DNA in dividing cells. Kidney function helps determine the prescribed amount.
agents.watch: Report fever, bleeding, hearing changes or an infusion reaction.
visual: It damages DNA in dividing cells. Kidney function helps determine the prescribed amount.

common_effects.title: Between visits
common_effects.text: Fatigue, taste changes and nausea can affect meals and daily activities. Take the prescribed anti-sickness medicines and call if you cannot drink.

common_effects.title: Numbness or tingling
common_effects.text: Tell the team before your next infusion if tingling, numbness or loss of balance affects walking or using your hands.

serious_effects.title: Infection and low counts · Chemotherapy
serious_effects.text: Call the unit immediately for fever, chills, heavy bleeding or suddenly feeling unwell.

serious_effects.title: Numb hands or feet · Paclitaxel
serious_effects.text: Report tingling, difficulty fastening buttons or a change in balance before your next dose.

serious_effects.title: Hair loss · Paclitaxel
serious_effects.text: Discuss headwear or scalp cooling with the team before the first infusion.

serious_effects.title: Hearing · Carboplatin
serious_effects.text: Report ringing in your ears or a change in hearing.

serious_effects.title: Lungs · Pembrolizumab
serious_effects.text: Call urgently for new cough or breathlessness.

serious_effects.title: Hormone glands · Pembrolizumab
serious_effects.text: Report severe tiredness, headache, unusual thirst or dizziness.

serious_effects.title: Heart or muscles · Pembrolizumab
serious_effects.text: New weakness needs urgent advice. Severe chest pain or collapse needs 112 or 999.

serious_effects.title: Bowel · Pembrolizumab
serious_effects.text: Call urgently for new diarrhoea, pain or blood in stools.

serious_effects.title: Liver · Pembrolizumab
serious_effects.text: Call for yellow eyes or dark urine. Blood tests can also detect inflammation.

serious_effects.title: Skin or hair · Pembrolizumab
serious_effects.text: Hair loss is common with paclitaxel. A spreading, blistering or peeling rash needs urgent help.

support.title: Pembrolizumab
support.text: Carry your immunotherapy alert card. New cough, diarrhoea, severe fatigue, excessive thirst or weakness need urgent review, including after treatment ends.

support.title: Paclitaxel
support.text: Confirm which steroid premedicines to take before paclitaxel. Tell the nurse immediately about flushing, wheeze or throat tightness.

support.title: Carboplatin
support.text: Kidney function helps determine carboplatin dosing. Report previous platinum allergy.

teachback: Which days are infusion days, and which symptoms mean you should call urgently?
consent_support: Discuss the expected benefit, side effects, fertility, alternatives and symptom-directed care with the treating clinician. You may ask for more time or change your decision.
safety_note: Call oncology urgently for fever, chills, new breathlessness or severe diarrhoea.
urgent_extra: Call oncology urgently for fever, chills, new breathlessness or severe diarrhoea.

evidence.title: KEYNOTE-826
evidence.interpretation: Adding pembrolizumab improved survival in people whose cervical cancer expressed PD-L1.
evidence.limitations: Bevacizumab use was selected by the treating team. The trial does not compare the two bevacizumab strategies.

monitoring_schedule.title: Tests and timing

rows.label: Before starting
cells: Blood count, kidney and liver function. Review medicines, allergies and current symptoms.
Bring a medicine list and details of previous treatment.

rows.label: Before each cycle
cells: Blood counts and organ function are reviewed with symptoms and fitness for treatment.
Tell your team if infection, tiredness or side effects limit normal activity.

rows.label: During immunotherapy
cells: Blood sugar, liver and kidney tests, and thyroid function every 3–6 weeks. Other hormone tests depend on symptoms.
Report new headache, thirst, weakness, cough or diarrhoea even between visits.

monitoring_schedule.note: Scan dates and tumour-marker testing are individualised by your oncology team.
